title: Hundreds of Thousands of Turtles Storm One Beach at Once

scenes.text: Hundreds of thousands of turtles land on one beach.
scenes.keywords: olive ridley turtles mass nesting beach

scenes.text: It's called an arribada, Spanish for arrival.
Female olive ridleys gather offshore, then crawl out together within a few days.
At Ostional in Costa Rica, drones counted about one turtle per square meter.
It happens once or twice a month in the rainy season, and scientists still don't know how they coordinate.
Hundreds of thousands of turtles, one beach, the same few days.

description:
Hundreds of thousands of olive ridley turtles can land on a single beach.
At Ostional in Costa Rica the mass nesting, called an arribada, packs the sand with about one turtle per square meter, and researchers still don't know how the turtles time it.
Have you ever seen a turtle nest?
first_comment: How do hundreds of thousands of turtles all agree on the same night?
